text: {"final": {"summary": "Added household ID format validation in register_household (registry/register.py), placed after the setdefault for id and before the append/save. The check verifies the ID starts with 'HH-', is 8 characters, has digits at indices 3-7, and that household_check_digit(id[3:7]) matches int(id[7]). Invalid IDs raise ValueError with a message including the rejected ID, before anything is written. Auto-assigned IDs from next_household_id (via make_household_id) pass unchanged, and registering without an ID still works.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
